scope: Macro-style observations from all 24 active reference homepage captures; separate current navigation inventory. This is not a new full visual subpage or mobile audit.
transferPolicy: New brand CI, own assortment and approved scope govern. Observations describe sources; principles and applications are editorial adaptations. Do not copy source colours, fonts, icons, images, claims, ASINs or product counts. No unseen subpage structure or interaction is inferred.

stores.macroStyle: minimal, photographic, concise
observations: Wide lifestyle lead with large short copy followed by a paired category row, a compact product-image row, another lifestyle lead and a large category pair.
Warm neutral photography and generous plain areas carry the products; small secondary labels replace explanatory paragraphs.
stores.observedHomeSequence: lifestyle lead → paired categories → compact product row → lifestyle lead → large category pair
transferablePrinciples: Alternate a small number of immersive category images with compact product/category groups.
Use a clear large heading and restrained supporting copy; carry the new brand CI rather than these exact warm settings.

Create contrast through scale and value using the target CI; do not copy black, athlete photography or the condensed font automatically.
